reviews.title: Text message system
reviews.text:
Unclaimed rides and cancelled rides used to notify in advance. This was very helpful deciding in next day’s schedule or next hour’s schedule. Now it’s unpredictable when or if the ride is going to get picked up. Uncertainties in busy schedules doesn’t help.
My son got tardy slip because of this issue.
It happened on 10/26/26. I will take any opportunity to complain about text message issues until it’s fixed.

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: The app works fine, but the rides are so inconsistent. We’ve regularly had 30+ minute late rides. Can’t wait to be done with them.

reviews.title: Not enough drivers
reviews.text: Not enough drivers and the very few drivers they have don’t help me as much to pick up my child. Also not enough time when they cancel your ride after no driver claims it

reviews.title: Horrible App
reviews.text: The app is incredibly buggy.  Every time I try to enter my credit card it says my security code is incorrect and charges my card.  Card won’t save but it continues to charge my card anyway.

reviews.title: They put your children in danger
reviews.text: I was deactivated when I agreed to pick up a little boy around 7 years old slightly later than expected, it would be dark out in Detroit and no one at his school, I thought I was doing the right thing. Ag the time i didn’t know that I even had a metrics. Hop Skip never showed me my metrics or my performance and this drove my on time metrics all the way down. My second offense was being late once more when a politician convoy blocked the freeway and I couldn’t pick up a student. I was later deactivated and hop skip refused to talk to the mother to confirm that I tried to help her son. Hop skip will endanger your children. They later denied my appeal after driving for 3 years.

reviews.title: Never any rides available
reviews.text:
I began using this rideshare service based on a recommendation, but it has been a frustrating experience. Out of numerous attempts, I have only secured four rides due to constant driver shortages. The pricing is steep—$18 for less than three miles—and booking in advance does not resolve the availability issues.

After speaking with customer service, I learned that school district students are prioritized, and confirmed private rides may be cancelled to accommodate them. This explains my recent cancellations, which were previously blamed on technical glitches. While other apps are even more expensive, Uber remains a more affordable and reliable alternative. Ultimately, this service has not met my expectations.

reviews.title: Lack of Communication
reviews.text: The app was great and provides a great service until we got a notice that the service in our area will be discontinued with less than a week notice.

reviews.title: Not reliable
reviews.text: They show up 30+ minutes late almost every day, different driver and car every day.

reviews.title: Horrible and disorganized.
reviews.text: I have been using this app for several months and I truly cannot put into words how much I hate it. Prices are UNREASONABLY high. I’ve resorted to using a nanny when I can, but sometimes, I still need to use it when she’s not available. I DREAD THE DAYS I HAVE TO USE THIS APP. Drivers almost never follow the instructions and are never in the right spot to pick my child up from school. Then, they would try to charge me a late fee, when they were the ones late for pick up. Literally every time I try to use this app, there is always some issue. The fair seems to go up every other week. They charge you still, when you cancel a ride. (God forbid your child is ill and doesn’t go to school that day ) apparently you will still be charged the full amount ! and drivers are always late and/or cancel last minute. My daughter has been left standing outside multiple times. Now today, I had her scheduled to be picked up at 4 PM and the driver canceled at 3 PM, leaving a new driver on the way, arriving at almost 5 PM. This is unacceptable. This is supposed to relieve stress for parents and all it has done is the complete opposite. I truly wish there were other companies that provided this service, because my experience with this company has been horrible and I would avoid using it altogether if I could. I STRONGLY DO NOT RECOMMEND this company
